info.title: EduTrio School ERP - API Contract
info.description: Single source of truth for every API: request payload and response. Frontend types, Zod schemas and MSW mock handlers MUST be generated/derived from this file. If a new endpoint is needed, add it here FIRST.

get.summary: Current user, tenant, permissions, active session

example.message: If the account exists, a reset link has been sent.

post.summary: School self-signup, creates tenant + super admin + trial

get.summary: Students card (independent so each card can fail/retry alone)
Header search across students, staff, pages

post.summary: Copy classes, fee structures, subjects into new session
Add student with guardians (auto fee assignment from class structure)
Bulk promote / detain / alumni at year end
Generate TC (blocked if dues pending unless override)
Generate ID cards PDF for selected students
Add staff and optionally create login

get.summary: Roster for class/section/date with existing marks

post.summary: Save whole class attendance (upsert, bulk). Default all PRESENT in UI.

put.summary: Set a cell. Server rejects teacher double-booking.

post.summary: Assign substitute teacher for a date
Create exam (wizard step 1-3 saved in one call)

get.summary: Exam detail with papers and marks-entry progress
Marks sheet for class/section/subject (teacher sees only assigned)

post.summary: Lock marks for a paper (teacher submit)
Use BULK_UPLOAD with entity MARKS (this is a shortcut that returns importId)
Publish results; requires all papers locked; notifies parents

get.summary: Report card JSON (PDF built on client or via REPORT_CARD_PDF)

post.summary: Generate report cards PDF for class
Generate admit cards (blocked for students with fee dues if setting enabled)
Create structure and generate fee lines for enrolled students
Assign extra/custom fee (e.g. transport) to a student

get.summary: All fee lines + payments for a student (collect screen)

post.summary: Collect payment against selected lines (idempotent). Returns receipt.

get.summary: Receipt data (client renders PDF) or pdfUrl

post.summary: Send due reminders to selected students' guardians
Compose and send/schedule notice via selected channels

items.name: Fee due reminder
items.body: Dear {{guardianName}}, fee of Rs {{amount}} for {{studentName}} is due.

example.name: Fee due reminder
example.body: Dear {{guardianName}}, fee of Rs {{amount}} is due.

get.summary: Teacher-parent chat threads for current user

post.summary: Start thread with parent of a student

put.summary: Update role permissions (system roles: only non-critical perms editable)

delete.summary: Delete custom role (blocked if users assigned)

get.summary: Grouped permission catalog for matrix UI

post.summary: Invite admin/user by email with role

get.summary: All available reports grouped by module (filtered by permission)

post.summary: Run report and get columns + rows (paginated preview). Client exports to xlsx/pdf/csv from this shape.
Server-side export for large reports (>5000 rows). Small ones are exported on client.

get.summary: Download blank xlsx/csv template with headers, sample row, and validation hints (entity: STUDENTS|STAFF|FEE_ASSIGNMENTS|MARKS|GUARDIANS)

post.summary: Upload file; server parses and validates all rows (no data written yet)

get.summary: Download xlsx of failed rows with error column so user can fix and re-upload

post.summary: Parent applies leave for child (visible to class teacher)
